user_story: As a user, I want to access the API endpoint documentation list so that I can understand the available APIs and their usage. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Automation Practice for API Testing'. 2. The heading 'APIs List for practice' should be present. 3. The panel for 'API 1: Get All Products List' should display the API URL 'https://automationexercise.com/api/productsList'. 4. The subscription input with placeholder 'Your email address' should be available. 5. The 'Subscribe' button should be present with the class 'btn btn-default'.
